It was contested by 19 teams, and [[Club Brugge K.V.]] won the championship.<br />
At the end of the season the division was reduced in size from 19 to 18 clubs, so three clubs were relegated to [[Belgian Second Division|Division II]] to be replaced by two promoted clubs.<ref name="rsssf">{{cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesb/belghist.html |title=Belgium – Final Tables 1895–2008 |publisher=The Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation |last1=Ploquin |first1=Phil |last2=Nackaerts |first2=Luc |last3=Coolsaet |first3=Jeroen |access-date=17 December 2018}}</ref>
